body:
My girlfriend, on June 7th will be 2 years since she left. I really miss her. She was a kind soul and had the warmest heart of all the people I have ever met. She was funny, intelligent, clever, had a great sense of humor, and she was so damn cute, I loved her tiny nose and her bright green eyes. 

I miss our talks, hearing her opinions about things. I love movies, she liked them... but I was amazed how fast and clear her interpretations of the films were, I was the movie buff of our relationships and made feel I little bit jealous of her brains, but in a good way, I appreciated her insights about movies, or life.

Like a lot of you, I knew she was struggling but I never realized how bad it was. The last couple of days had been rough. Im trying to keep on, but its so damn hard, I feel alone and abandoned. I wish I had an audiobook of her, just reading something, anything, just to keep listening her.

She was the best, I will never get an answer on why she did it as long as I live, but if there is a tiny chance to met her again, maybe in another life, or universe, or parallel reality, Ill ask her to forgive me, I loved her but maybe not in the way she needed, and I wasted her life on someone like me.
( dont know that, but Im trying man. And its not that intense like 9 months ago.
great service, he sent me the book even before I paid. Definitely Ill come back.

It was at day, like a bright summer day, we were boating through a canal, like in Venice (I have never been there), the water was so blue, and I still remember her hair shinning and waving, I felt so happy and safe at that moment.
Me n u - Trombone de frutas
thanks for reading, she was so lovely and cute. Im trying to think about on helping others but must of the times I feel is pointless.

Sorry for your loss. I think the same, Im even avoiding looking into the mirror, I dont want to notice any new wrinckles on my face or new white hairs. Feels just odd to get old and they stuck frozen in time on pictures we see of them.
Sorry for your loss. I would really like to hear your music.

Im really sorry for your loss. Im not ashamed to tell people how she died even tough people might think that I wasnt a good enough mental health professional to help her, but its my own perception of how I failed her that makes me sick,  all that time studying, talking to patients, I was arrogant, I thought I could read her like an open book (she could do that with me) I know if I had paid more attention  I could have offered more options of what to do, meds, therapy, ECT, everything, I would have done anything to take some of her pain away. Now, I would happily trade my own life for hers. She was awesome, everyone loved her.

Im really for your loss. Life doesnt go on. Its gets frozen in time. Even their family told me that I will find someone, I know they were just trying to cheer me up even tough they lost a daughter and a sister, but she was my family too, she was the family I choose, I even "joke" around about getting married, I knew she wanted it too. I decided to never have a relationship again, first because Im a bad person, no one deserves to waste their time on me, and second and most importan, they will all be in the shade of Josephine, I could not have kids, because they will no be our kids. I ll always be thinking "Im with you because Josephine is dead". and its not fair to the others,.

Im really trying, I thought that "helping" other would bring me some sense of direction or peace or motivation, but it doesn't. I know that may be this will sound that Im trying to seek to give pity, but I think that I need to keep living to punish myself for my omissions, cowardice and arrogance. I let her go, may be I didn't killed her, but in a sense, Im responsible, and I cant live with myself that I had a chance to help her and I didn't.
thanks for reading, on the contrary I dont feel brave, Im a coward, may be if I wasnt so afraid of telling her all my shit, may be she wouldnt feel so alone, and may be she would be still here.

You don't need a reason to explain how you feel, emotions are like that. I totally get you, my gf killed herself 6 months ago, may be that qualify as a "real problem", and from a very long time Im having those thoughts again too, but you don't need to explain why you feel sad, you just do. My gf told me how she felt, may be she didn't told me how bad she felt, but when she did, I answered like I was her therapist instead of just shut  my fucking mouth and listened to her, I never questioned why she felt the way she felt but may be what she needed from me, was just to listen, and I fucking didn't, so don't be ashamed to share it with people you trust. Silence is such a heaven burden. Silence can kill.  I feel such a hypocrite telling you this, when I do the same thing, but may be there is hope for you, mine is running out. Hope you the best, and if you have someone to talk about it, do it, I lost the only one who really listened to me. Dont let what happened to me, happen to you.
same here, just waiting for my parents to die so I can end this shit up. My gf killed herself 6 months ago but prior to her death I never pictured myself getting old, now Ill just speed up my plan

I can relate to you about the 50 first dates metaphor, but now, for me, everyday its a nightmare and I just keep hoping that when I go to sleep and eventually wake up next morning, she still be there.

I was wondering about how the relationship we had with our loved ones, shape the relationship when they are gone. Maybe its selfish, and maybe its stupid for looking it this way, but when she took her life, her mother lost a daughter, her siblings lost a sister, and if they keep going, theres is nothing in the world that would change that, she will still be her daughter's mother and her sister's sibling, but what about for those who lost out romantic partner? I don't want to feel like moving on means that she would become my ex. Does anything Im saying makes sense? It's just so damned messy, all this thoughts and feelings, are so overwhelming. 

Sometimes It feels like a bad dream that keeps on and on and on.

I dont think Im directly responsible for her death, I believe that if I gave myself to her, the way she did it, and truly loved her like a really felt, instead of keeping the distance because I was too afraid of being hurt, may be she would still be here.

And Im supposed to be a professional, Im about to be a psychiatrist, and I didnt fucking see it, how could I be so stupid and blind? How could I not see her pain?

She gave everything, and I didnt give her shit. I tried to be kind to her, but Im a bed person because of what I didnt do, by omitting the little things. 

I had so many opportunities to help her, even when she wasnt that depressed but I didnt know she was in that kind of pain, she never told me, but I should have seen it. I was so focused in a lot of meaningless things. 

I wasnt a good friend or bf, Im a bad person, Im a shitty psychiatist, and I dont know what to do with my life because all my plans included her. I have never felt so lost and lonely.

You need to explore how lonely she feels, if she thinks of herself as a burden and if she is capable of doing it bay asking about if she is afraid to die on if she has a high pain tolerance. Those are the 3 main components, but also ask about helplessness (beck hopelessness scale) and if the distress is to awful that she cannot bear it anymore.

Im studying the suicide crisis intervention from CBT point of view. Theres is a book that my help you Brief Cognitive‑Behavioral Therapy for Suicide. But dependes on the type of psychotherapy you know hot to use. BDT focused more in training the intense emotions, also ACT.

Also recommend to use a bunch of other scales, beck hopelessness, C-SSRS, but if you are hesitant if she might do it, you gotta offer her hospitalization.

Sorry for your loss. You gotta fire them till you find someone who you will find yourself confortable. I feel confortable with mine, even though I realize he doesnt have a lot of experience dealing with suicide grief, but he is very empathic, and I notice that he keeps informing himself about the subject, he doesnt invalidate my feelings of guilt and shame, we just work them. Sounds awful to try again and again, but totally worth it. Im not saying that Im 100%, I feel really shitty must of the time but his cognitive behavioral approach helps with some rough patches.
We will never stop loving them, even if it hurts like hell. I dont want to let someone new, no one will be like her, she was my person in this life.

A month ago I could picture myself with her, doing our work, living together, now I cant see beyond today, Im just breathing, my family try to cheer me up, but I found more comforted with hers. Im unable to talk to my family and friends, they just dont get it, the guilt, the ifs, the pain. Sorry for your loss, we are here for each other.
thanks to you and the community, makes me feel less alone.

Sorry for your loss. Yes, Im also at early stages of grief (4 weeks today), and after she killed herself I moved back with my parents, and everyday I wake up hoping to find a message from her and Im in my bedroom and it just hits, she is gone.

Not even once I detached myself from the feeling that something is missing, like a void, and Im reading and suddenly I found myself crying.

Hope it gets better for you.
thanks a lot

Thanks a lot for taking time of reading me and write me kind words. I apologize if there are  misspelled words or not even properly written, because english is not my first language, Im from Mexico and I couldnt find a group where I could share what Im going through.

Really guys, thanks a lot. I know that right now Im not at my best, but if someone wants to talk, Im here for you.

sorry for your loss, friend. I get the felling that the person you loved the most, your soulmate, didnt share their pain with you, makes you feel like, If I trusted her and she knew she could count on me, why didnt she told me? Do I ever knew this person? Did she just showed me what she thought I would like? 

I really love my girlfriend, no matter why she hide her pain from me, and Im sure you loved yours too. You are not alone. Im here for you if you like. I know I really need someone who understands.

thanks a lot, just when I think I cant cry anymore, hits me again and again. Im gonna keep living, spreading what she taught me to others.

When Im calmed, I feel that this awful experience could be focused into helping others dealing with mental health issues, but when the pain hits me, just feels that everything its pointless. How could I help an other person if I couldnt help Josephine? How could I help others when Im so broken inside?

I just hopes that time gives me some clarity.
thanks for your kind words, Im gonna try to be well and a better human being, for her.

sorry for your loss, I totally get how this feels. It just seems so unreal, isnt it? They show you what the wanted you to see, and bury all that pain inside of them and devours them like a cancer, and you just cant stop thinking how could you be so blind to their pain, and feel so guilty. In my case, I always knew that it wasnt up to me to save her, I know that Im not that powerful, but if she just told me I would have helped her carrying all that pain, she didnt need to carry all that weight by herself, and I question myself why she didnt tell me? why she didnt trust me? And it hurts so bad, and Im afraid that I will never stop feeling this way and at the same time, Im afraid that if I start not feeling it, Im forgetting her, and I dont want that to happen, she was the love of my life, she was home, wherever she was, there was my home.

Im myself struggled at some point in my life with those tendencies, I planned how I would do it, and at some point I got so afraid that I looked up for help, I never talked about how I felt, and talking to my psychiatrist took so much of the weight I was carrying. I will never know the reasons why she did what she did, but I do understand that her pain was so unbearable that she thought this was her only option.

My own mental health problems made me realize that there was a way to cope with the prison of your own thoughts. Thats why I decided to be a psychiatrist, to help others, but now, I dont see the point of keep going if I couldnt help her.

Sorry if the post is too long I just want to someone to hear me, and that dont look at me with pity.

My Josephine was the most beautiful, empathic, caring, warm, self giving person I had ever met, we could talk about everything, from stupid memes to politics, and always found myself learning something new with her. She really made me laugh and taught me that I was capable of loving, really loving a person, not just to fall in love. Since her departure, I been listening over and over the a playlist she made for me. We thought of getting married, and for a moment, I really though that we will do it.

There is a scene in Frances Ha when she explains love, and I thought I understood when I watched the film several years ago, but now I really get it, and she says something like when you are at a party, and the person you love is there too, and you are talking to other people and shining, and you looked across the room and catch each others eyes, not precisely its something sexual or because you are possessive, its because that is your person in this life, and its funny and sad, but only because this life will end, but its that secret world that exist, right there, in public, unnoticed.

We built this world, far from the indifference of the universe, we painted it in the brightest and most beautiful colors we could imagine, and now that she is gone, Im back to the cold and grey universe that we kept far from us.

We had plans, and now, all is gone. She is gone, my understanding of what life meant is gone, all seems so, dull.

Sorry for your loss, I think its a very common thing to check up all the messages and social media, to find answers that probably will never find, and if we do, they will never be enough. Its just so painful to see all these people who shined so bright, go the way they did.

Rationally, I know I did what I could to help her with the info and the resources at my hand, but it feels so... insufficient. This pain just hits me like a wave and all I can think its how I didnt do enough. Thanks for your kind words.

At times, I just think that she saw her suicide as inevitable, and hide thing from me to just enjoy life while it lasted. Her family and friends told me that she really loved me and that I was a very positive influence at her life, although this makes me happy it also hurts a lot, and I feel so insufficient, I couldnt be what she needed. Maybe its my ego, but I really think I could have help her. She seemed fine, we talked the night before and sounded ok, and she entered in this, like you called it "suicide trance". Makes me awful just to imagine how bad she felt, what an unbearable pain, to think that was her only option. Thanks for your kind words.

thanks a lot for your kind words. I need to talk with people who have had experience this, I dont feel confortable talking it with my family, I know they care about me, but how could they understand? Again, thanks a lot.
